source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A parent started with node --input-type=module cannot pass that option to a worker which loads a file. The local knowledge model previously failed with ERR_INPUT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED; its generic exit message then hid the cause. Filter only --input-type and retain the other Node options. Report the first worker failure once. The regression tests passed, and the same inline-script call returned a valid 384-value vector after the fix. This concerns the local knowledge model worker; it does not establish a general Thunderbird code rule.
title: File-based Node workers must exclude inline input options
